what: After ctor fns were built at their bodiless rows (a2b1388119), every tempo census panicked before INSTANCES: Walk::repr -> layout -> Adts::drop_impl -> Front2Program::adt_drop_impl -> in_world `expect`ed a body. The ctor tests passed because their no_core prelude declared no `Drop` lang item, so drop_impl never reached the seam.
cost: every census after the admission, until this fix
cause: the seam's world for a question (Drop impl, selection, projection, instance) was always the asking row's BODY world, and an `expect` asserted every built row has a body
whys: the back half was assumed to build only bodies; ctor fns and their Fn shims are built at a row with no body; the questions asked are at ground arguments and need no body's scope, but the world type was made only from a body; the test fixtures omitted the lang item that routes to the seam
class: a seam answer that needs a body world, asked for a row that has none
prevention: done: world_items.rs `ctor_world` (the ADT's own scope) answers for a ctor row, eager and lazy; `in_world` returns a typed `ResolveError::Missing(FnSig(fn))` for any other bodiless row and for a body with no spelling, never panics; test front2_ctor_fn.rs `a_ctor_with_a_drop_field_*` declares `Drop` so the seam is reached
